posts.text: Eid ul-Adha greetings! May this occasion deepen the spirit of brotherhood and happiness in our society. Praying for everyone's success and good health.
posts.caption: Eid ul-Adha greetings! May this occasion deepen the spirit of brotherhood and happiness in our society. Praying for everyone's success and good health.

posts.text: PM @narendramodi will address the 134th episode of Mann Ki Baat today at 11 AM. Tune in on All India Radio, DD News and official digital channels.
posts.caption: PM @narendramodi will address the 134th episode of Mann Ki Baat today at 11 AM. Tune in on All India Radio, DD News and official digital channels.

posts.text: Directed all agencies to expedite storm relief operations across affected districts. Every family impacted will receive compensation within 24 hours. We stand with the people of Uttar Pradesh.
posts.caption: Directed all agencies to expedite storm relief operations across affected districts. Every family impacted will receive compensation within 24 hours. We stand with the people of Uttar Pradesh.

posts.text: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'Vishwa Guru' but can't conduct even one exam — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.
posts.caption: NEET. CBSE. SSC. And today CUET. Four exams. One crore children. Not a single one conducted with honesty. Claims of 'Vishwa Guru' but can't conduct even one exam — Modi ji has completely ruined the entire education system.

posts.text: Directed all DMs to remain in the field and ensure immediate relief and rescue. Power supply must be restored at earliest in storm-affected areas. Medical teams on standby for all emergencies. No negligence will be tolerated.
posts.caption: Directed all DMs to remain in the field and ensure immediate relief and rescue. Power supply must be restored at earliest in storm-affected areas. Medical teams on standby for all emergencies. No negligence will be tolerated.

posts.text: The country needs an educated PM. CUET exam centres across Varanasi — students told the server is not functioning. This is what happens when education is not a priority.
posts.caption: The country needs an educated PM. CUET exam centres across Varanasi — students told the server is not functioning. This is what happens when education is not a priority.

posts.text: Pleased to call on President U Min Aung Hlaing of Myanmar in New Delhi today. Appreciate his positive sentiment towards deepening our longstanding bilateral cooperation. Look forward to his meeting with PM @narendramodi to advance our partnership for peace, progress and prosperity.
posts.caption: Pleased to call on President U Min Aung Hlaing of Myanmar in New Delhi today. Appreciate his positive sentiment towards deepening our longstanding bilateral cooperation. Look forward to his meeting with PM @narendramodi to advance our partnership for peace, progress and prosperity.

posts.text: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue to drive employment and economic expansion. Budget 2026 balances fiscal discipline with ambition — India remains firmly on a high-growth trajectory.
posts.caption: Structural reforms, productivity gains and technology adoption will continue to drive employment and economic expansion. Budget 2026 balances fiscal discipline with ambition — India remains firmly on a high-growth trajectory.

posts.text: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. From ports to green energy to airports, we are building the backbone for the next century of growth. Proud to be part of this transformational journey.
posts.caption: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. From ports to green energy to airports, we are building the backbone for the next century of growth. Proud to be part of this transformational journey.

posts.text: Technology and connectivity are transforming lives across India. Jio's mission has always been to empower every Indian with affordable digital access. The best is yet to come.
posts.caption: Technology and connectivity are transforming lives across India. Jio's mission has always been to empower every Indian with affordable digital access. The best is yet to come.

posts.text: I truly believe that the values of integrity, humility, and giving back to society will always define true success. India's greatest strength is its people.
posts.caption: I truly believe that the values of integrity, humility, and giving back to society will always define true success. India's greatest strength is its people.

posts.text: Padma Awards 2026 were conferred on 66 personalities in recognition of their exceptional contributions. Their dedication inspires the nation to strive for excellence.
posts.caption: Padma Awards 2026 were conferred on 66 personalities in recognition of their exceptional contributions. Their dedication inspires the nation to strive for excellence.

posts.text: The Strait of Hormuz must immediately open. No tolls. Remove the mines. Ships trapped there may start to go home. Say HELLO to your wives, husbands, parents, and families from me, your favorite President!
posts.caption: The Strait of Hormuz must immediately open. No tolls. Remove the mines. Ships trapped there may start to go home. Say HELLO to your wives, husbands, parents, and families from me, your favorite President!

posts.text: The government's handling of the economy continues to fail working families. Rising costs, stalling growth, and broken promises — Britain deserves better leadership and a real plan for the future.
posts.caption: The government's handling of the economy continues to fail working families. Rising costs, stalling growth, and broken promises — Britain deserves better leadership and a real plan for the future.

posts.text: On one hand, I really didn't want to respond because it's so dumb. On the other hand, it's Exhibit A of how toxic politics works & it happens often enough that I feel some obligation to lift the curtain on how the game is played.
posts.caption: On one hand, I really didn't want to respond because it's so dumb. On the other hand, it's Exhibit A of how toxic politics works & it happens often enough that I feel some obligation to lift the curtain on how the game is played.

posts.text: Proud to represent our nation and honored by every opportunity to serve. The strength of America is in its communities and families coming together.
posts.caption: Proud to represent our nation and honored by every opportunity to serve. The strength of America is in its communities and families coming together.

posts.text: Accountability and transparency — that's what the American people deserve. We will continue to pursue the truth and ensure our institutions serve the people, not the other way around.
posts.caption: Accountability and transparency — that's what the American people deserve. We will continue to pursue the truth and ensure our institutions serve the people, not the other way around.

posts.text: AI policy is moving faster than anyone expected. The US must lead with innovation and smart regulation — not fear. Excited about the progress we're making at the White House AI office.
posts.caption: AI policy is moving faster than anyone expected. The US must lead with innovation and smart regulation — not fear. Excited about the progress we're making at the White House AI office.

posts.text: Development is the most important pillar for the Global South. At the World Bank, we are committed to ensuring that financing reaches where it's needed most — climate, infrastructure, and human capital.
posts.caption: Development is the most important pillar for the Global South. At the World Bank, we are committed to ensuring that financing reaches where it's needed most — climate, infrastructure, and human capital.

posts.text: This is not our war. We will not be drawn into the conflict. The most effective way to support the cost of living in Britain is to push for de-escalation and a re-opening of the Strait of Hormuz. We've brought 35 nations together around maritime security.
posts.caption: This is not our war. We will not be drawn into the conflict. The most effective way to support the cost of living in Britain is to push for de-escalation and a re-opening of the Strait of Hormuz. We've brought 35 nations together around maritime security.

posts.text: Australia stands with our allies on the importance of free navigation through international waterways. A stable Indo-Pacific is essential for our security and prosperity.
posts.caption: Australia stands with our allies on the importance of free navigation through international waterways. A stable Indo-Pacific is essential for our security and prosperity.

posts.text: Europe must build its own strategic autonomy. We cannot depend on others for our security, our energy, or our technology. The world is changing — France and Europe must lead, not follow.
posts.caption: Europe must build its own strategic autonomy. We cannot depend on others for our security, our energy, or our technology. The world is changing — France and Europe must lead, not follow.

posts.text: The UAE continues to invest in the future — AI, space, clean energy. Our vision is to build a nation that leads the world in innovation and tolerance. The best way to predict the future is to create it.
posts.caption: The UAE continues to invest in the future — AI, space, clean energy. Our vision is to build a nation that leads the world in innovation and tolerance. The best way to predict the future is to create it.

posts.text: Using our own AI (Grok) to prove the security of Bitcoin. Fascinating results. The intersection of AI and crypto is just getting started.
posts.caption: Using our own AI (Grok) to prove the security of Bitcoin. Fascinating results. The intersection of AI and crypto is just getting started.

posts.text: The number of people using our AI glasses daily has tripled year over year. We launched Ray-Ban Meta Optics for all-day wear, and new partnerships are coming later this year. The future of computing is on your face.
posts.caption: The number of people using our AI glasses daily has tripled year over year. We launched Ray-Ban Meta Optics for all-day wear, and new partnerships are coming later this year. The future of computing is on your face.

posts.text: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. If they shifted 80% of workloads to Gemini 3.5 Flash, they'd save over $1 billion annually. That is real savings they can pour back into their company.
posts.caption: Companies are already blowing through their annual token budgets and it's only May. If they shifted 80% of workloads to Gemini 3.5 Flash, they'd save over $1 billion annually. That is real savings they can pour back into their company.

posts.text: 2026 is a pivotal year for AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. The next leap is product discipline, not just bigger models. AI should be scaffolding for human potential, not a substitute.
posts.caption: 2026 is a pivotal year for AI. We've moved past discovery into widespread diffusion. The next leap is product discipline, not just bigger models. AI should be scaffolding for human potential, not a substitute.

posts.text: We've been roughly right on technological predictions and pretty wrong on the social and economic implications. I'm delighted to be wrong about AI wiping out white-collar jobs.
posts.caption: We've been roughly right on technological predictions and pretty wrong on the social and economic implications. I'm delighted to be wrong about AI wiping out white-collar jobs.

posts.text: Apple Glasses are my top priority. We're designing our own frames with oval cameras, unique colors, and multiple styles. The glasses will evolve into a health device and eventually incorporate AR. See you at WWDC on June 8.
posts.caption: Apple Glasses are my top priority. We're designing our own frames with oval cameras, unique colors, and multiple styles. The glasses will evolve into a health device and eventually incorporate AR. See you at WWDC on June 8.

posts.text: Demand has gone parabolic. Agentic AI has arrived and is scaling rapidly. We'll invest $150 billion a year in Taiwan — the epicentre of the AI revolution. Many years ago we had 10 partners. Five years ago, 50. Now we have 150.
posts.caption: Demand has gone parabolic. Agentic AI has arrived and is scaling rapidly. We'll invest $150 billion a year in Taiwan — the epicentre of the AI revolution. Many years ago we had 10 partners. Five years ago, 50. Now we have 150.

posts.text: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — has created the foundation for AI-powered governance at population scale. The next decade will see AI amplify this stack in ways we're just beginning to imagine.
posts.caption: India's digital public infrastructure — Aadhaar, UPI, DigiLocker — has created the foundation for AI-powered governance at population scale. The next decade will see AI amplify this stack in ways we're just beginning to imagine.

posts.text: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we need to make sure it benefits everyone — especially in healthcare and education for the developing world. That's where the real impact will be.
posts.caption: AI is the most transformative technology of our lifetime. But we need to make sure it benefits everyone — especially in healthcare and education for the developing world. That's where the real impact will be.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. At IBM, we're seeing clients deploy AI agents that handle real workflows. The companies that move fastest on adoption will define the next era of business.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental — it's operational. At IBM, we're seeing clients deploy AI agents that handle real workflows. The companies that move fastest on adoption will define the next era of business.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they're amplifying each other. Adobe Firefly is helping millions of creators do their best work faster. The creative economy is just getting started.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not at odds — they're amplifying each other. Adobe Firefly is helping millions of creators do their best work faster. The creative economy is just getting started.

posts.text: Building in AI requires a different kind of engineering discipline — one that accounts for uncertainty, safety, and human oversight from the start. Excited to be working on these hard problems.
posts.caption: Building in AI requires a different kind of engineering discipline — one that accounts for uncertainty, safety, and human oversight from the start. Excited to be working on these hard problems.

posts.text: Luxury and technology are converging in exciting ways. At Chanel, we believe in craftsmanship that embraces the future while honouring heritage. Innovation must always serve human creativity.
posts.caption: Luxury and technology are converging in exciting ways. At Chanel, we believe in craftsmanship that embraces the future while honouring heritage. Innovation must always serve human creativity.

posts.text: Global commerce is being reshaped by AI and automation. At FedEx, we're investing in intelligent logistics that make supply chains faster, greener, and more resilient. The future of delivery is data-driven.
posts.caption: Global commerce is being reshaped by AI and automation. At FedEx, we're investing in intelligent logistics that make supply chains faster, greener, and more resilient. The future of delivery is data-driven.

posts.text: When we finally lifted that trophy in 2025, it felt like a lifetime of weight was lifted off my shoulders. I thought that was the peak. But to stand here today, in 2026, holding it again — this team is special. Back to back! 🏆🏆
posts.caption: When we finally lifted that trophy in 2025, it felt like a lifetime of weight was lifted off my shoulders. I thought that was the peak. But to stand here today, in 2026, holding it again — this team is special. Back to back! 🏆🏆

posts.text: We understand that winning trophies is not easy. You need to win 17 games in just two months. My focus is not on just saying 'we will win trophies,' but on ensuring we do the right things. If we do that, success will follow.
posts.caption: We understand that winning trophies is not easy. You need to win 17 games in just two months. My focus is not on just saying 'we will win trophies,' but on ensuring we do the right things. If we do that, success will follow.

posts.text: I don't know I'm coming for the next game. One of the things is the pride factor. Home advantage is very important which we haven't been able to capitalise on. It's also the first season after a fresh auction.
posts.caption: I don't know I'm coming for the next game. One of the things is the pride factor. Home advantage is very important which we haven't been able to capitalise on. It's also the first season after a fresh auction.

posts.text: Tough season — won't hide from that. Came back from the World Cup with a niggle and had to manage it through the IPL. Now focused on getting fully fit and coming back stronger. The work never stops.
posts.caption: Tough season — won't hide from that. Came back from the World Cup with a niggle and had to manage it through the IPL. Now focused on getting fully fit and coming back stronger. The work never stops.

posts.text: Not the season we wanted for MI. Take full responsibility as captain. We gave our best but it wasn't enough this time. Will reflect, learn, and come back stronger. Grateful to the fans who stood by us.
posts.caption: Not the season we wanted for MI. Take full responsibility as captain. We gave our best but it wasn't enough this time. Will reflect, learn, and come back stronger. Grateful to the fans who stood by us.

posts.text: Congratulations to @RCBTweets on winning consecutive @IPL titles. After winning once, the task is no longer proving you can do it, but proving you can sustain it. RCB met that challenge impressively this season. A well-deserved achievement!
posts.caption: Congratulations to @RCBTweets on winning consecutive @IPL titles. After winning once, the task is no longer proving you can do it, but proving you can sustain it. RCB met that challenge impressively this season. A well-deserved achievement!

posts.text: What a phenomenal IPL 2026 season. RCB's consistency has been outstanding — back-to-back titles is a rare achievement. Cricket in India continues to set new benchmarks every year.
posts.caption: What a phenomenal IPL 2026 season. RCB's consistency has been outstanding — back-to-back titles is a rare achievement. Cricket in India continues to set new benchmarks every year.

posts.text: Congratulations @RCBTweets on winning the IPL 2026! 🏆 Back-to-back champions — only the third franchise in IPL history to defend the title. A spectacular season of cricket! #IPL2026Final
posts.caption: Congratulations @RCBTweets on winning the IPL 2026! 🏆 Back-to-back champions — only the third franchise in IPL history to defend the title. A spectacular season of cricket! #IPL2026Final

posts.text: An incredible IPL 2026 season comes to a close! RCB join an elite club as back-to-back champions. Meanwhile, all eyes now turn to the international calendar. Cricket's future is bright. 🏏
posts.caption: An incredible IPL 2026 season comes to a close! RCB join an elite club as back-to-back champions. Meanwhile, all eyes now turn to the international calendar. Cricket's future is bright. 🏏

posts.text: RCB are your IPL 2026 Champions! 🏆🔥 A dominant campaign capped off with a 5-wicket victory over GT in the final. Virat Kohli stars with an unbeaten 75 off 42 balls. What a season! #TATAIPL2026
posts.caption: RCB are your IPL 2026 Champions! 🏆🔥 A dominant campaign capped off with a 5-wicket victory over GT in the final. Virat Kohli stars with an unbeaten 75 off 42 balls. What a season! #TATAIPL2026

posts.text: New coach, new chapter. Fully focused on the 2026 Asian Games and Commonwealth Games. The setback in Tokyo was tough, but I've learned a lot. Excited to open my season and chase bigger throws.
posts.caption: New coach, new chapter. Fully focused on the 2026 Asian Games and Commonwealth Games. The setback in Tokyo was tough, but I've learned a lot. Excited to open my season and chase bigger throws.

posts.text: Training hard and staying focused for the upcoming season. Every day on the court teaches me something new. Grateful for the support and excited for what's ahead. 🏸
posts.caption: Training hard and staying focused for the upcoming season. Every day on the court teaches me something new. Grateful for the support and excited for what's ahead. 🏸

posts.text: Sports teaches you resilience like nothing else can. To every young athlete out there — stay patient, keep working, and trust the process. Your moment will come.
posts.caption: Sports teaches you resilience like nothing else can. To every young athlete out there — stay patient, keep working, and trust the process. Your moment will come.

posts.text: Tough day against Keymer at Norway Chess. Thought I was comfortable after the opening, but things slipped away quickly. Still four rounds to go — the fight continues. Thank you for all the support! ♟️
posts.caption: Tough day against Keymer at Norway Chess. Thought I was comfortable after the opening, but things slipped away quickly. Still four rounds to go — the fight continues. Thank you for all the support! ♟️

posts.text: Indian football keeps growing and I couldn't be prouder. The passion of our fans is unmatched. Whether on the pitch or off it, the beautiful game in India has a bright future ahead.
posts.caption: Indian football keeps growing and I couldn't be prouder. The passion of our fans is unmatched. Whether on the pitch or off it, the beautiful game in India has a bright future ahead.
